messages:
Sam (Support Lead): Morning — quick coverage check. Currently 42 open tickets, 7 high, 2 regressions (embeds mismatch T-8122, billing webhook double-charge T-8119). Need coverage 09:00–13:00 PST. Who's taking embeds triage?
Mira: I'll take the billing webhook dup (T-8119). ETA ~45m. starting with logs.
Alex: I can own embeds until 11:00 PST. Seen a couple requests falling back to CPU, link to traces: https://redwood-internal/traces/abc123
Jordan: on high-priority queue until 11:00. If embeds spike again please @Jordan
Priya: Macro suggestion — add cache-clear + escalation step. Draft below:
```macro
Title: Embed regression - quick triage
Steps:
1) Identify affected model + request IDs
2) Run `curl https://internal/kvcache/flush/<key>`
3) If CPU fallback, pin to `model-v1-quant` and @eng-ml
4) Escalate to oncall if >10% errors in 10m
``` 
Sam (Support Lead): Nice — @Alex can you open PR to ops-macros and assign to @Priya for review? Also deploy-bot reported a canary rollout finished at 02:12 (tokencache) — seems stable.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout tokencache/2026-02-12 complete — 6k requests sampled, latency +0.2% vs baseline. https://deploys.redwood/canary/5678
Mira: Billing fix pushed to staging; smoke tests pass. Will promote if green in 20m.
Alex: pinned fallback to `model-v1-quant` for bad paths; token latency down ~30% in canary. Will monitor.
Priya: :thumbsup: Opening macro PR now: https://github.com/redwood/ops-macros/pull/204
Sam (Support Lead): If anyone gets a surge after the embed fix, tag tickets with `embed-regression` and ping #eng-ml. Thanks team :rocket:
